parsed.why: Parent 0.35 plus a documented protective layer: full facility access, self-ID documents, hate-crime coverage, court-ordered care resumption, consent-decree custody relief. Pending ballot measures and national funding override temper but do not negate the protective regime.

Most-protective tier: anti-discrimination enforcement available to refused visitors, hate-crime enhancements, surgery-free documents, panic-defence ban, lowest per-capita trans-killings. Only open questions (unresolved school-board suits) hold it below stronger tiers.

Protective tier with shield law, deep anti-discrimination coverage and open documents; but documented birth-sex custody placement with attack and no baseline housing rule is a concrete universal-exposure custody gap, tempering the protective score.

Sanctuary state with strong protective law and low incident counts, but two trans women shot dead in one city within ten weeks — undenominated yet current — plus unresolved custody placement keep it below the safest tier.

Hostile layer on top of parent: birth-sex facility mandate in schools, 2026 licence-marker ban, supreme court denial of trans name change, no GI protections, statutory refusal licence, care ban. Highest-risk-tier state materially below national average.
